title: Headroom lease: short-term capacity leases, gradual invoice amortization, and tenant soft-fairness
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Customers on Dedicated need predictable throughput SLOs but occasionally require short-term additional throughput for traffic spikes. Current behavior pulls from shared fleet headroom and bills immediate overage at standard rates, causing surprise invoices and high support load. Goal: implement a short-duration capacity lease system that meters extra capacity separately, amortizes charges across the billing period, and exposes opt-in controls and previews to customers. Scope: allocator lease lifecycle, lease metering, billing reconciliation with amortization, console opt-in + preview, and logging/audit hooks. Non-goals: changes to reserved commitments or long-term capacity purchases. Approach: create time-boxed leases (preset durations: 5m/30m/2h) with per-tenant caps; track lease usage in a separate meter (lease_bucket); add amortization logic in billing pipeline with configurable smoothing window per tenant; apply a soft-fairness score during contention that favors active leases but caps advantage to prevent starvation; implement graceful degradation policies (model fallback or reduced throughput) before lease revocation; surface amortized charge previews and notifications in Console and CSV exports.
acceptance_criteria: Allocator can create and revoke time-boxed leases with durations 5m, 30m, and 2h
Lease usage is recorded in a dedicated lease_bucket and appears in per-tenant Grafana dashboards
Billing pipeline converts lease_bucket usage into amortized ledger entries using tenant-configurable smoothing windows
Console provides opt-in toggle, active leases list, and amortized charge preview for the current billing period
On fleet contention, soft-fairness algorithm prefers active leases but caps advantage to prevent downstream starvation
Staged traffic experiment shows <1% unexpected lease revocations and no SLO regressions for non-lease tenants
Notification system sends amortization alerts when amortized charge exceeds 10% of tenant's expected monthly spend
